sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A representation of things and the connections between them.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Think of people and places on a map, with labeled lines explaining how they relate.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: Joule Studio and SAP can be represented as distinct entities connected through an evidence-backed assertion.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Neo4j stores entities alongside document lineage, assertions and governed records.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Connections support questions that a list of isolated paragraphs cannot directly express.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: The Explorer graph is a documentation map; its nodes and edges are not the runtime ontology.

sections.title: Implementation
